entities.name: Greel
entities.description: A humanoid horror in league with the Keldons and Phyrexians who masqueraded as a Keldon and fed on life force; killed by Barrin.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: Warriors of Jamuraa whom Greel masqueraded as and was in league with.

entities.name: Erissa
entities.description: A bog witch for whom Greel served as familiar.

entities.name: Doyenne Latulla
entities.description: An artificer for whom Greel served as familiar.

entities.name: Rayne
entities.description: Barrin's wife, who traced the Phyrexian plague to Greel and was killed by him.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Husband of Rayne, who killed Greel with magical sparks.

entities.name: Phyrexian plague
entities.description: A plague spreading on Jamuraa, originating with Greel.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Beings Greel was in league with.

entities.name: Keldon Invasion
entities.description: Invasion of Jamuraa during which Greel was active.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: Continent on Dominaria where the events occurred.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Greel lived.

events.summary: Rayne identifies Greel as the plague's origin and tries to kill him, but he is unfazed.
events.quote: Rayne pinpointed the origin of the plague to Greel.

events.summary: Greel kills Rayne after she is knocked off her artifact steed.
events.quote: When Rayne was knocked off her artifact steed, Greel killed her.

events.summary: Barrin kills Greel with magical sparks.
events.quote: killing the horror by dissolving him rapidly from within

relations.note: Killed her after she was knocked off her steed
relations.quote: When Rayne was knocked off her artifact steed, Greel killed her.
Barrin cast a cascade of magical sparks onto Greel
He served as a familiar for the bog witch Erissa and the artificer Doyenne Latulla
